acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a backyard tiny home in San Diego County varies based on size, design complexity, finishes, and site-specific preparation. Factors like utility connections, foundation work, and desired amenities significantly influence the total investment. While basic units might start in a certain range, custom features and higher-end materials will increase the overall price.
